# Pranav Mishra

> Founding LLM Engineer at Alfred_, a multi-agent assistant over email, calendar, SMS and voice for five thousand people. I own working memory, the rules engine, the eval harness, inference cost, and the Postgres and ingestion underneath. Before that: AI engineer at WheelPrice, research software engineer at UIC, and a long tail of games and XR.

This site is one page: the work at Alfred_ in five measured figures, thirty projects, two papers, and a pixel room at the bottom. Everything here is written in the first person and every number on it shipped.
